subject: U-442 integrated: PR #485 open on the review base, 2 P1s held
body: Merged origin/review/2026-09-20-tracker-sweep (0f8cb8a2) into u-442 with zero conflicts, verified the merged head 5a57c8d2 green (unittest: Ran 1714 tests in 277.248s, OK; validate.py: All 21 missions valid, exit 0; scoped gitleaks over the branch diff: 3 commits, no leaks), wrote egress receipts before each off-repo write, pushed, and opened PR #485 with baseRefName asserted == review/2026-09-20-tracker-sweep. Greptile returned at 163s (inside the 10min cap, no did-not-run checkpoint) with two P1 comments on runtime/scripts/verify.py; I adjudicated both VALID against the code and HELD them unfixed — (1) the tracked-at-head_sha branch in _read_artifact reads through the SHA root, so with the roots split a path present in both trees is served from the wrong repo and its artifacts[] sha256 pin is never checked, which contradicts the --evidence-root help text and is reachable by construction in a self-chain, and (2) check_symbol_on_base at :1720 bypasses the root-aware _git helper while the adjacent check_base_ancestry at :1711 resolves the same origin/<base> ref through it. Left for you: a builder round on both P1s — the first weakens the #267 pinning guarantee that build-u442.md's stop condition explicitly protects, so grade it against the frozen spec before merge; note also that committing the report advanced the PR head to a5f84978, so the Greptile review at 5a57c8d2 no longer satisfies reviewed_sha == head_sha and needs a re-review, and I did not merge the PR.
